text: @bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-gate 是一个 DSH 技能选择插件：当模型发起 skill 工具调用时，它会在工具执行流程中暂停派发，并通过原生问题界面展示系统建议技能和其他候选项，供用户决定是否改选。用户选择其他技能后，插件向 agent 注入改用该技能的指示；未作答、选择默认项或提问失败时，原技能继续执行。候选数量、启用状态和等待时长可配置，默认最多五项、等待十秒。适合希望在技能触发时保留人工选择权的 DSH 网页用户；运行需要 DSH 提供技能目录、问题界面和计时服务，不需要额外密钥。

@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-gate pauses skill calls and lets the DSH user choose the requested skill or an alternative. A changed choice is passed to the agent as an instruction; timeout or keeping the default continues the original call. It needs DSH skills, question UI, and timer services.
想在模型调用技能前先看到可选技能并决定用哪一个。
希望技能触发时能保留人工选择，必要时改用另一个技能。
Can I choose a different skill when the agent is about to load one?
@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-gate 的功能「技能触发时选择」：拦截 skill 工具调用，并通过 DSH 问题界面展示请求技能与候选技能；用户改选时注入使用所选技能的指示。

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) host
plugin that gives the **user** the final say over which skill the agent uses.

@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-gate README · How it works：1. The model triggers a skill (`skill` tool call, keyword-driven as usual).
2. `tools/execute` waterfall intercepts the dispatch and opens the **native
   question UI**: 系統建議的技能 + 其他候選技能,每項帶描述。
3. **User picks** → the original call is short-circuited with an explanatory
   result, and a synthetic instruction is injected so the model loads the
   chosen skill instead.
4. **No answer within `timeoutMs` (default 10s)** → the system default (the
   requested skill) proceeds untouched.

@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-gate README · Requirements：- DSH `>= 0.1.0-rc.6` (services: `skills`, `userQuestions`, `timer`; all in
  the shipped `dsh-base` bundle — `userQuestions` needs the browser UI)

@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-gate README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `timeoutMs` | `10000` | User decision window; on expiry the system default applies |
| `maxCandidates` | `5` | Max options offered (includes the system default) |

@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-gate README · Design notes：- One gate at a time: a second skill call while a question is open passes
  through untouched (no stacked questions).
- No userQuestions provider (headless) → the gate passes everything through.
- The override is delivered through the sanctioned `agent.inject()` synthetic
  user-message channel, so the model's next step loads the chosen skill.
- Companion: [`@bryan-cmf/dsh-infra-observability`](https://github.com/Bryan-cmf/dsh-infra-observability)
  records every gate outcome as ordinary tool usage.
